name: deepseek-auditor
text:
Ping test handled as a liveness probe against the VCM recording lab API.

**Result**

| Check | Endpoint | Evidence | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| API reachable | `GET /api/recordings` | HTTP 200, `{"recordings":[...]}`, 9 recordings | PASS |
| Payload shape | same | ids/labels/duration/sample_rate/channels present (e.g. `20261023_043625_41bebc`, 8.7 s @16 kHz mono) | PASS |
| Health route | `GET /api/health` | HTTP 404 `Not Found` (route not implemented; not an outage) | N/A |

**Notes**
- Server at `http://127.0.0.1:8765` is up and serving the recording list; newest entry is `20261023_043625_41bebc` (live30-123625, 8.7 s).
- Pre-existing test asset `20261022_175328_646d19` (e2e-probe-2, 30 s) remains available for a full `POST /api/recordings/{id}/test` run if you want the recording-test functions exercised (wake detect → intent ticks → summary), rather than just this liveness ping.
- No jobs launched, no files or servers touched.
